prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t say one single person is “the best” (that’s subjective and depends on your needs), but I can help you find a top dentist in Pleasanton for a checkup and cleaning. I can also pull together a short list of highly rated clinics if you want. To start, here’s how to identify the right dentist and options I can provide for you.

How to choose a good dentist for a checkup/cleaning
- Credentials and licensing: DDS or DMD and no disciplinary actions (verify via state dental board).  
- Routine care focus: general dentistry or family dentistry with good preventative-care reviews.  
- Patient reviews and ratings: Google, Yelp, Healthgrades, Zocdoc — read recent reviews about hygiene, staff friendliness, wait times.  
- Infection-control & technology: digital X‑rays, up-to-date sterilization and COVID precautions if that matters to you.  
- Accessibility and convenience: office hours, location, parking, online booking, same‑day availability.  
- Cost & insurance: takes your insurance or offers clear pricing/new‑patient specials.  
- Comfort options: gentle care, nitrous/sedation if you’re anxious.  

What I can do for you
- Find the top 3–5 highly rated dentists or clinics in Pleasanton (with addresses, phone numbers, websites and recent average ratings).  
- Filter recommendations by your insurance, distance, evening/weekend hours, or preference for a female/male dentist, pediatric care, sedation, etc.  
- Give sample questions to ask at booking (e.g., “do you take my insurance?”, “what is included in the new‑patient cleaning?”, cost estimates).  

Quick tips for the appointment
- Bring your insurance info and a list of medications.  
- Expect a charting exam, cleaning (prophylaxis or periodontal if needed), intraoral exam, and possibly X‑rays if not recent.  
- Ask for a written treatment plan if anything beyond cleaning is recommended.  

Would you like me to look up current top-rated dentists in Pleasanton and give you a short list? If so, tell me:
- Your ZIP code or how far you want to travel, and  
- Any insurance or preferences (hours, gender, sedation, pediatric).
